blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) flagged Lapu-Lapu City for inappropriately displaying the local chief executive’s (LCE) name and motto on government properties. COA’s observation report noted the displays of the name and motto of the mayor on various motor vehicles distributed to several barangays and offices of the city, which were […]...
